Companion Animal Travel Desk topic on preparing pets for travel

Traveling with an animal is smoother when you plan ahead and keep each step simple. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is set up to help travelers bring pets with care, calm, and the right papers.

Before you travel, check that your animal is comfortable with its carrier, harness, or leash. Keep identification current and make sure food, water, and any comfort items are packed in a tidy way. Trained staff treat every animal with patient attention, and prompt, respectful communication helps everything move along without confusion.

If your trip includes a large dog, <<FACT F057>> Place the usual travel documents together so they are easy to show when asked, and keep the animal settled during check-in and boarding. Aisha Mensah found it easier to sort her paperwork early, and that helped her focus on Toby's comfort instead of last-minute stress.

For rabbits and other small companions, health paperwork matters just as much. <<FACT F082>> Keep the document clean, easy to read, and ready for review. If you are unsure about carrier size, bedding, or what can travel in the cabin, the staff can walk you through the basics in a calm way.

At the airport, stay nearby and follow directions from the travel team. Keep your animal on a leash or inside the carrier unless a staff member tells you otherwise. Fatima Adeyemi appreciated how the process stayed organized, and she said that clear instructions made the day feel less rushed.

A little preparation goes a long way. When you organize documents, pack thoughtfully, and stay in touch with the Companion Animal Travel Desk, you give your pet a better travel experience and make check-in simpler for everyone.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
